reason_not_run: M0/M1 metadata-only phase; no GEE credentials exercised and no bulk server interaction. Live execution must be added behind the gee_integration pytest marker.

scope.grid: China Albers 10 km, W10000 coastal cells

hard_rules: metadata properties only; zero pixel export; ee.batch.Export forbidden
static nominal-frame prefilter: intersect cell union with MGRS tile (S1/S2) and WRS-2 descending path/row (Landsat) footprints once, offline
one batched getInfo per (nominal_frame, year, sensor); never per cell
nominal frame membership is a PREFILTER only; actual scene geometry is gated at census time (S1 mandatory; S2 retains the M2.1b lesson that MGRS nominal membership is not true ground coverage)
no cloud/quality filtering in the census: report candidate counts, VALID/SCL status is a downstream production gate, not inferred
S1 DN vs gamma0 collections are never mixed; ALOS L-band gap 2011-2014 is reported, not filled

sensor_contracts.notes: Level-2 Collection 2; path/row footprints via WRS-2 index
SLC-off after May 2003 must be flagged as a quality status
Operational from late 2021; national coverage from 2022
No MGRS/WRS equivalent; nominal frames biased (the #13 171/105 finding). Per-frame actual footprint cache required before per-cell eligibility.
MGRS tile is a prefilter; multi-tile datatakes join on DATATAKE_IDENTIFIER (the #13 3-datatake finding); actual contributing tile geometry required for eligibility

frame_prefilter.method: 1) load static MGRS tile polygons and WRS-2 descending scene footprints; 2) spatial-intersect the union of coastal cell polygons; 3) persist deterministic frame lists (frame_id, system, intersecting_cell_ids) in work/national/census/; 4) frame x year x sensor query matrix derived from those lists.
frame_prefilter.frame_count: UNKNOWN (computed only when the static indexes are added)

query_scale.upper_bound_naive_cell_queries: FORBIDDEN (would be cells x years x sensors)
query_scale.batched_query_units: frame x year x sensor; exact count UNKNOWN until prefilter runs

execution_note: Design executed 2026-10-03/04 as metadata-only census (getInfo batched property reads + S1 actual footprints; zero pixels, ee.batch.Export guard installed). The reason_not_run field below is retained as the original M0 design rationale for traceability.
